fact_text: Oil marketing company margins have risen roughly 30 percent after earlier dealer margin increases, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: The OMC margin on petrol is about 82 paisa per litre, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: An OMC model built on PSO's sales of about 1 trillion rupees implies a gross margin of roughly 7 to 8 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: PSO is owed about 700 to 800 billion rupees in circular debt, mainly by Sui Northern Gas Pipelines, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: The analyst said SNGP may start paying, which would stop circular debt from building and improve PSO's cash position.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: Attock Petroleum holds about 10 to 11 percent of the volume handled in oil marketing, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: Shell Pakistan's books have improved since it had negative equity two to three years earlier, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: Shell's Dutch-Anglo parent is selling its Pakistan business to Wafi Energy, a Saudi entity, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)

fact_text: The analyst said oil marketing companies look better placed, with stronger margins and cash flows and less risk of circular debt building up.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Soars with Improved PSO Outlook | Valuation Analysis' (YouTube, 2023-12-01)
